# lines.library: DotNormal

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> The dot product of the plane's normal with a displacement: the component of
> that displacement along the normal. Translation-invariant, so Distance plays
> no part.

```plato
DotNormal(pl: Plane, value: Vector3D): Number
```
